decisions.reason: Accepting a high-minimum-quantity connector purchase does not change the required PCB production export files.
The sourceability fallback does not change the requirements for board-specific BOMs or JLCPCB assembly part numbers.
Purchasing the connector at its required minimum quantity does not alter connector pin-label content or placement.
The connector purchasing fallback does not change the requirement to validate component orientations in JLCPCB.
The candidate already requires placing missing parts in the cart for the client to order; accepting the connector's minimum quantity does not necessarily change any order-configuration attribute.
The source decision concerns a high-MOQ connector, not the independently selected prototype or production buzzer.
Connector procurement cost and minimum quantity do not alter connector placement, orientation, alignment, or cable routing.
The connector sourceability fallback does not affect LED supply voltage, data drive, level shifting, or the selected LED part.
The source does not change the charge-status circuit, external LED connector, resistor, or population requirements.
The sourceability decision does not identify or change the battery connector family, pitch, pin count, functions, or unresolved pin order.
Connector purchasing terms do not affect the ESP32 antenna placement at the PCB edge.
Accepting a high-MOQ connector purchase does not change the three-board architecture or the assigned roles of the main and sensor boards.
